messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not double up on a day you were not meant to take a dose"
set: ["do not double up on a day you were not meant to take a dose", "do not double up to catch up", "do not double up if dose is not controlling symptoms", "do not take a missed dose during the day", "do not take two doses to make up for a missed dose", "do not take the missed dose if you miss a dose of the tablets", "do not take an extra dose", "do not reuse a needle", "Do not take two doses at once to make up for a missed one", "do not take to lose weight", "take once a day", "do not give to a child without a doctor's advice", "do not take more than recommended dose", "do not use a kitchen spoon", "taken up to three times a day", "do not use a second device unless you are told to"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
